boundary.description: From the bend on the Rossendale Way near Grain Book, by a bee-line to Rossendale – Rochdale District boundary near Higher hill, then E and SE along that boundary to River Spodden, and S along River Spodden to College Road. S along College Road and Bury Road (B6222) to the point opposite Bridgefield Street, then E by a beeline to and S along River Roch to and N along Queen’s Park Road, Bury and Rochdale Old Road, then N along Ashworth Road to its junction with School Lane and W by a bee-line to and W along Cheesden Brook to Rossendale -Rochdale District boundary, to the point near Deeply Vale, and by a beeline to include Closes Farm. N by a beeline to the junction of Croston Close Road and Rochdale Road (A680), then in a straight line, following Cheesden Brook, to the bend on the Rossendale Way near Grain Brook.
